video_title: Ja Morant Media Availability | Oct. 8, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant evaluates his first preseason game with the Trail Blazers
quotes.excerpt: definitely could have been better offensively. I was a little passive. I just got to be more decisive.
quotes.quote: On a scale of one to ten, I would say probably a six and a half. Definitely could have been better offensively. I think what the guys told me, but going back and watching, I was a little passive. I just got to be more decisive when I have the ball and know what I want and where I want to go with the ball.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on adjusting to playing with new teammates
quotes.excerpt: I got so many guys on the floor that can do, yeah, like I feel like now it's not like
quotes.quote: It is playing with new guys and then I got so many guys on the floor that can do, yeah, like I feel like now it's not like Ja going to score 30. So I kind of had that pretty much stuck in my head out there playing and that kind of had me in spot time. I didn't like being in. Obviously talking with the coaches last night, today and then with Dame yesterday, they were just telling me to stay aggressive. Obviously when I'm playing like me, it opens up a lot more on the floor for everybody else.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on the challenge of balancing playmaking and scoring
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I'm a natural point guard. I'm not selfish at all, so that's a definitely a tough part.
quotes.quote: It is tough because I feel like I'm a natural point guard. I'm not selfish at all, so that's a definitely a tough part. Even in that third, Danny like, nah, we about to run it again and you going to drive again. That's kind of like, I wouldn't say it's new, but it's just different, like a different mindset for me knowing that, you know, I like to pass the ball but also can score. So, like I said, it's a balance.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on bringing joy to his new team
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it's just the same joy. I just feel like now being around a new team
quotes.quote: I feel like it's just the same joy. I just feel like now being around a new team and these guys, they get to see it. Obviously my joy and stuff was in Memphis in previous years, so you had the players there saying it. Obviously my opponents don't get to see too much of that side. So now, being around them every day, sitting in the locker rooms, whatever it is, joking and just coming in with energy and stuff, you know, they get to see that.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on the potential of teammate Scoot Henderson
quotes.excerpt: he ready. He ready for sure. Definitely been opening some eyes and been very impressive since we stepped
quotes.quote: Twin, yeah, he ready. He ready for sure. Definitely been opening some eyes and been very impressive since we stepped foot here. I just continue to tell him the same thing that they was telling me. Every message that I get passed on, I know he pretty much can get down hill and do the same thing, you know, I do on the offensive end. So my job is, you know, if I hear it from me, knowing somebody else, you know, can do the same thing, I'm going to tell him the same thing.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on building chemistry with Damian Lillard
quotes.excerpt: we constantly talking, communication. Obviously we've been around, played against each other, so we kind of know each
quotes.quote: We constantly talking, communication. Obviously we've been around, played against each other, so we kind of know each other's tendency. It's just, you know, finding those within the offense and you know what we want to accomplish out there on the floor. I won't say it's been hard, but I won't say, you know, we got it down pack yet either. We still got some work to do for sure.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on Damian Lillard's playmaking and floor spacing
quotes.excerpt: with Danny, his ability to be able to, you know, get down the floor, get downhill and finish
quotes.quote: With Danny, his ability to be able to, you know, get down the floor, get downhill and finish through contact or without contact is extreme plus for us. And the more we can get him in, you know, open space and let him see those gaps, it'd be great for us. So me and Dame's job is to, you know, continue to, you know, just make sure everything in the right place, everybody's in, you know, the right spots and their strengths and, you know, just let them go be them.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on the unselfish nature of the team
quotes.excerpt: he has tell me to come get the ball when I be trying to give him the ball
quotes.quote: He has tell me to come get the ball when I be trying to give him the ball. That's crazy for me now. Like we both, we all kind of going through the same thing. Like it's like we all trying to, you know, make sure everybody get their, you know, their share of, you know, the basketball. But I feel like with our style and the way we play, it'll come along and how y'all seen yesterday with how the floor opened up for Danny, you know, yesterday is, yeah, I feel like, you know, each and every game it should be somebody new for sure.
